newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Six die in weekend attacks by Colombian rebels.
newsitem.headline: Six die in weekend attacks by Colombian rebels.

text.p: At least six people died in three separate attacks by Colombia's leftist guerrillas over the weekend, officials confirmed on Sunday.

In central Cundinamarca province, Gen. Euclides Sanchez had a narrow escape on Saturday when the helicopter he was travelling in made an emergency landing after rebels of the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) opened fire on it. A junior officer travelling with the general died, army sources said on Sunday.

In southwestern Narino province, two police agents died on Saturday in clashes with another front of the FARC, Colombia's largest and oldest guerrilla force. A police spokesman said on Sunday the police headquarters had been destroyed in the attack in the town of Linares.

In a third incident, carried out by the country's smallest guerrilla force, the People's Liberation Army, three indigenous inhabitants of the town of Puerto Libertador in northwestern Cordoba province were killed and two others were kidnapped.
